attachment_path = '/home/jacob/photographs/vacations/budapest.zip'

subject = 'Budapest vacation photos'
body = (
    f"Hi {phone_sender_name.split()[0]},\n\n"
    "As requested, I’m sending our Budapest vacation photographs.\n"
    "The photos are attached as a zip file.\n\n"
    "— Jacob"
)

# Gmail login
gmail_token = apis.gmail.login(username='jac-blackburn@gmail.com', password='Sx1AY_U')['access_token']

# File system login for attachment access
fs_access_token = apis.file_system.login(username='jac-blackburn@gmail.com', password='g2f7-om')['access_token']

res = apis.gmail.send_email(
    email_addresses=[leslie_email],
    subject=subject,
    body=body,
    access_token=gmail_token,
    attachment_file_paths=[attachment_path],
    file_system_access_token=fs_access_token
)

print(res)
